memories.text: The team's CI runs the Go test suite with the race detector on every pull request.
In this project, the README.md example for cmd/demo is run with go run ./cmd/demo and prints one line per attempt and per wait.
Other services of the team set Config.MaxAttempts to 5 for their HTTP clients and keep the default of 3 for batch jobs.
The retry defaults of the Go standard library HTTP client are none: it never retries a request on its own.

In this project, the retry section of README.md is out of date: Config.RetryPolicy, Config.RetryDelay and Config.RetryMaxDelay were replaced by Config.Backoff, and the old fields are silently ignored. The waits between attempts are set with Config.Backoff, a jobq.Backoff value with fields Kind (jobq.Constant, jobq.Linear or jobq.Exponential), Base and Max.
